summary: Add "number of games played" tracking to auth server, require certain number of games to get certain jobs

comments.content:
New players shouldn't be able to take captain, AI, etc, right away, cause
they always fuck it up. This'd be probably the simplest way to enforce
that, although there should probably be a way for admins to override it.

I like this.
A lot.

Think of it like "unlocks" in other MMO games.

Don't forget to make "Doctor" require a lot of plays as well. People can learn how to
play the doctor by playing an assistant to medical first.
